newsitem.title: USA: CME March S&P 500s fall 15-pt intermediate limit.
newsitem.headline: CME March S&P 500s fall 15-pt intermediate limit.

text.p: CME March Standard & Poor's 500 futures fell the 15-point intermediate price limit in fast-market conditions.
Trade activity halted for two minutes at 1430 CST/2030 GMT, and S&Ps re-opened another 5.00 points lower.
The next limit would be at down 45.00 points. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com))
